senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; כָּוָה)burnt spot on the skin, burn.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 9:1">Neg. IX, 1</cite> <he>כל שהוא מחמת האש זו היא מ׳</he> all wounds produced through fire (directly or indirectly) are called ‘burns’.
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 8:7">Ib. VIII, 7</cite> <he>מחיית המ׳</he> the cicatrization of a burn.

<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 9:2">Ib. IX, 2</cite>; Sifra Thazr., Neg., Par. 4, ch. VII <he>אין שחין ומ׳ וכ׳</he> an inflammation and a burn cannot be combined (to make up the minimum size required for uncleanness); a. fr.
